notes: Set-up: the bot is the one place to talk; another branch or Recheck reads the code base again; tools are found anywhere on the laptop and every click shows at once (a tick changes the list instantly, no reload); copies of a tool in a drop-down with Use; Discovery (the USB scan) is the last part of the Setup page and asks for a missing probe tool by itself; Pack makes a release zip (images, a README to flash them and see the output, checksums) with a Download button in the chat; when the board stays dark after a flash while its IDE works, Nova matches the IDE's build and flash and tries again; new popups.
